title: Day 2 Kessling's Report
author: Michael Kessling
summary: Michael Kessling posted a pointer to his DecipherCon 2000 Day 2 report, which he hosted off-site on Angelfire.
notes: Pointer only: the full report was posted off-site at www.angelfire.com/ga3/TREPORT2 (part 1 was at /TREPORT, Decktech d1319). Kessling says he posted it there to avoid censorship. No games or results are in this text.
Byline Michael "Troop1023" Kessling; [[Michael Kessling]] redirects to [[Mike Kessling]], whose page gives the same Troop1023 handle, so author_link is Mike Kessling.

Event is the 2000 World Championship Day 2 (Friday 6 October) per the title. The hub has Kessling taking the missing Michael Riboulet's Naboo seat and finishing 54th, 4 (−57); none of that is in this post.
Gaudreault's report (d1333) records beating 'Michael Kessling' (Hunt Down) by 19 in Day 2 game 5.
